Good understanding of SQL and data analysis.

Familiar with Python, Metabase, and Odoo is a plus.

Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.job_title: Data Analyst – Transform Data into Actionable Insights (Surabaya)
jobs.job_description: Are you a data-driven problem solver with a passion for turning raw data into meaningful insights? CV Green Mile Indonesia is seeking a Data Analyst to join our innovative team in Surabaya! We’re not just looking for someone who excels in theory—we want a creative, analytical thinker who can code, innovate, and grow alongside us.At CV Green Mile Indonesia, we believe data is the backbone of smart decision-making. As a Data Analyst, you’ll play a pivotal role in analyzing complex datasets, identifying trends, and providing actionable recommendations that drive business growth. Whether it’s optimizing operations, improving customer experiences, or uncovering hidden opportunities, your insights will shape the future of our organization.Join a dynamic team where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning are valued. If you’re ready to leverage your analytical skills to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!Why work with us?Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment with a focus on data-driven solutions.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve real-world business challenges.Access opportunities for professional growth and skill development.Competitive salary and benefits tailored to your expertise.Be part of a company that values creativity, adaptability, and a growth mindset.Key Responsibilities:Data Collection & Analysis: Gather, clean, and analyze large datasets using SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy), or other relevant tools to extract meaningful insights.Reporting & Visualization: Create clear, compelling reports and dashboards (using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to present findings to stakeholders.Trend Identification: Identify key trends, patterns, and anomalies in data to support strategic decision-making.Business Intelligence: Collaborate with teams to translate data insights into actionable business strategies and recommendations.Automation & Scripting: Develop scripts or workflows (e.g., Python, R, or Excel VBA) to automate repetitive data tasks and improve efficiency.Performance Metrics: Define and track KPIs to measure business performance and suggest improvements.Stakeholder Communication: Present findings to non-technical stakeholders in an accessible and impactful manner.Stay Updated: Keep abreast of emerging data tools, techniques, and industry best practices to enhance analytical capabilities.Technical Requirements:Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy), and Excel (advanced). Familiarity with data visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI is a plus.Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and derive logical conclusions.Problem-Solving: Creative approach to tackling data challenges and proposing innovative solutions.Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a collaborative environment.Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to data accuracy, ensuring high-quality outputs and reliable insights.Industry Knowledge: Understanding of business metrics, market trends, or industry-specific data (advantageous but not mandatory).Apply Link Form Jobs : https://globaljob.sbs/form/jobs
